claim.claim-text: 1. A first radio-frequency identification, RFID, reader (102) comprising:

a first antenna element (114), wherein the first antenna element (114) is configured to facilitate a first transmission of a first interrogation command to a first RFID tag (110) associated with a second RFID reader (104, 600), and in response to the first transmission of the first interrogation command, receive a first response signal; and a second antenna element (116), wherein the second antenna element (116) is configured to facilitate a second transmission of a second interrogation command to one or more second RFID tags (112), wherein transmitting the second interrogation command is concurrent to receiving the first response signal or concurrent to transmitting the first interrogation command.
2. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 1, wherein the second antenna element (116) is further configured to receive a second response signal from the one or more second RFID tags (112).

3. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 2, wherein the first RFID reader (102) further comprises a communication module configured to transmit data received in the first response signal and/or the second response signal to a central server (106).
4. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 3, wherein the central server (106) is configured to monitor availability of one or more assets based on data received from the first RFID reader (102).
5. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 1, further comprising a first noise cancellation circuit (210) configured to generate a first noise free response signal.
6. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 1, further comprises a memory unit configured to store a list of second RFID readers along with respective unique IDs.

7. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 6, wherein the first RFID reader (102) is further configured to select the second RFID reader (104, 600) out of the list of second RFID readers prior to transmitting the first interrogation command.

8. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 6, wherein the memory unit is further configured to store a first data obtained from the first RFID tag (110) and/or a second data obtained from the one or more second RFID tags (112).
9. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 1, wherein the first RFID reader (102) and the second RFID reader (104, 600) communicate wirelessly.

10. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 6, further comprises a first processor (202), a first communication interface (206), and a first RFID reader unit (208) to determine whether the first interrogation command has been transmitted to each of the list of second RFID readers.

11. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 1, wherein the first antenna element (114) and/or the second antenna element (116) has 5 dbm output power and provide 35 dbm effective isotropic radiated power (EIRP).
12. The first RFID reader (102) of claim 1, wherein the first interrogation command includes a unique ID and an address associated with a second memory unit of the second RFID reader (104, 600).

14. A system (100) comprising:

a first antenna element (114) configured to: facilitate a first transmission of a first interrogation command to the first RFID tag (110), and in response to the first transmission of the first interrogation command, receive a first response signal; and

a second antenna element (116) configured to: facilitate a second transmission of a second interrogation command to the one or more second RFID tags (112), wherein transmitting the second interrogation command is concurrent to receiving the first response signal or concurrent to transmitting the first interrogation command.

15. The system (100) of claim 14, wherein the first RFID reader (102) further comprises a communication module configured to transmit data received in the first response signal to a central server (106).
